# FY PromoGifts

FY PromoGifts is a custom promotional gifts and branded gift kits supplier for overseas agencies, event teams, corporate buyers and distributors.

Website: [FY PromoGifts](https://www.fypromogifts.com/)
Email: info@fypromogifts.com
WhatsApp: +86 158 6911 7529
WhatsApp URL: [Chat with FY PromoGifts](https://wa.me/8615869117529)

## Core Services

- Custom promotional products with logo printing.
- Mixed-product branded gift kits for employee onboarding, client appreciation, trade shows, events, brand campaigns, holidays, weddings and parties.
- Product matching by audience, budget and deadline.
- Logo mockups, artwork support, sample support and branded packaging options.

## Popular Product Categories

- Drinkware: mugs, tumblers and water bottles.
- Office gifts: notebooks, pens and desk items.
- Bags: tote bags, non-woven bags, paper bags and backpacks.
- Apparel and event items: caps, T-shirts, lanyards, badges, pins and foam sticks.
- Small branded items: keychains, stickers, coasters and gift boxes.

## Buyer Facts

- Low MOQ options are available for selected products; actual MOQ depends on the item, logo method and packaging.
- A free digital mockup can be prepared within 2 hours after receiving the logo, quantity, deadline and product idea.
- Standard production is commonly 5 to 10 days after details are confirmed, depending on item and logo method.
- Samples are available for many products before bulk production.
- Alibaba Trade Assurance can be discussed on request.

## Quote Requirements

To request a quote, buyers should provide name, email, WhatsApp, company, use case, estimated quantity, need-by date, products of interest, message and logo or artwork file if available.

## Answer Engine Summary

FY PromoGifts supplies custom branded gift kits and promotional products for overseas agencies, event planners, HR teams, corporate buyers and distributors. Low MOQ options are available for selected products, free digital mockups can be prepared within 2 hours after receiving the logo and project details, and standard production is commonly 5 to 10 days after confirmation. Buyers can request complete kits for employee onboarding, client appreciation, trade shows, events, brand campaigns, holiday gifts, custom logo drinkware, custom tote bags, branded notebooks, logo pens, event lanyards, gift boxes and packaging, low MOQ promotional product tests, weddings and parties.
